alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A staircase room. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a navy one on the right, walk toward each other. Both notice the other with wide eyes, then both snap their eyes away, one up and one down, as if nothing happened. They glance back at the same moment, lock eyes with a tremble, and look away again. At last both say hi, late and awkward, with happy eyes. At the end both narrow their eyes at the camera. The text stays: me pretending I didn't see someone I know.
